subject: [PATCH v3 05/18] selftests/mm: keep khugepaged out of the swapout the swap cases set up

reviews.author: Mike Rapoport

The reviewer suggested that the patch description could be improved by splitting it into paragraphs and possibly rewriting it manually, rather than relying on automated tools.

2026-08-13.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to prevent khugepaged from interfering with swapout operations. The test pages out a range of memory and waits for the swap count to confirm, but khugepaged can undo this by reading back in the swapped-out pages. To avoid this issue, the patch keeps the range out of khugepaged's reach while waiting for the swap count. If the pages still cannot be swapped out after retrying, the test skips the operation. The patch addresses a problem where the test fails on arm64 systems with 64K pages due to khugepaged undoing the pageout operations.
